articles.summary: Hyperfine today announced it has priced its previously announced underwritten public offering of 14,000,000 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock at a public offering price of $1.25 per share.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces Pricing of $17.5 Million Public Offering

articles.summary: Strong evidence supports the use of AI-powered portable MRI for stroke detection in multiple clinical settings, including the emergency department.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces Publication of Breakthrough Clinical Data Demonstrating the Swoop® System’s Enhanced Stroke Detection Capabilities

articles.summary: Hyperfine, Inc. will report full Q3 2025 financial results on Nov. 13, 2025. Management will host a corresponding conference call at 1:30 PM PT / 4:30 PM ET.
articles.title: Hyperfine, Inc. to Announce Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results on November 13, 2025

articles.summary: Hyperfine initiates the launch of the next-generation Swoop® system in Europe, beginning global expansion of its most advanced portable MRI technology. ‌
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces European Launch of Next-Generation Swoop® System

articles.summary: Swoop® portable MRI system receives CDSCO approval in India, expanding access to advanced brain imaging in a large, fast-growing healthcare market.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces Regulatory Approval of the Swoop® System in India

articles.summary: Hyperfine secures FDA clearance for new DWI sequence, significantly expanding the Swoop® system's clinical capabilities in acute neurological care.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces FDA Clearance of the First Optive AI™ Software Update with Advanced Diffusion Imaging Capability, Focused on Enhancing Stroke Detection with the Swoop® System

articles.summary: Hyperfine launches study to assess Swoop® System use in neurosurgical ORs, advancing accessible brain MRI across care settings.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces First Patients Enrolled in PRISM PMR to Evaluate the Use of Next-Generation Swoop® System in the Operating Room Setting

articles.summary: Hyperfine, Inc. plans to present at the upcoming Piper Sandler 37th Annual Healthcare Conference on Thursday, December 4th at 8:10 AM ET.
articles.title: Hyperfine, Inc. to Participate in Upcoming Piper Sandler 37th Annual Healthcare Conference

articles.summary: Next-gen Swoop® system and the latest Optive AI™ software receive CE and UKCA marks, bringing Hyperfine’s most advanced portable MRI technology to European markets.
articles.title: Hyperfine Receives CE and UKCA Marks for Next-Generation Swoop® System and Latest Advancement in Optive AI™ Software

articles.summary: AIIMS New Delhi has begun clinical use of the Swoop® system, becoming the first hospital in India to deploy bedside MRI.
articles.title: Hyperfine Swoop® System Introduced as India’s First Portable MRI for Bedside Brain Imaging at the Country’s Leading Medical Institution

articles.summary: Leading neurosurgeons will help guide the role of the Swoop® system in neurosurgical care, including workflow, product capabilities, and evidence.
articles.title: Hyperfine Forms Global Neurosurgery Advisory Council to Support Expansion of Portable MRI in Neurosurgical Care

articles.summary: PRIME study results show bedside portable MRI cut order-to-scan time vs conventional MRI and identified critical ED findings.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces Presentation of Results from the PRIME Study Showing Portable MRI Substantially Reduces Time to Imaging in Emergency Departments

articles.summary: Hyperfine announced that it has commenced an underwritten public offering of its Class A common stock or, in lieu of Class A common stock to certain investors, pre-funded warrants to purchase Class A common stock.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces Proposed Public Offering

articles.summary: $3.7M grant supports expanded use of portable MRI to evaluate brain development and guide targeted health interventions in underserved communities.
articles.title: Hyperfine Awarded $3.7 Million Grant to Advance Global Brain Health

articles.summary: Hyperfine is expected to join the broad-market Russell 3000® Index and the small-cap Russell 2000® Index at the conclusion of the June 2026 Russell Reconstitution.
articles.title: Hyperfine to Join Russell 2000® and Russell 3000® Indexes

articles.summary: Hyperfine announces Swoop® system scan volume milestones at key hospitals and neurology clinics, demonstrating accelerating adoption across the US.
articles.title: Hyperfine Swoop® System Scan Volume in the United States Hits Record Milestones Across Multiple Sites of Care

articles.summary: Prospective study is designed to evaluate the feasibility and visualization benefits of contrast-enhanced ultra-low-field portable MRI.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces Enrollment of First Patient in Study to Expand Intended Use of the Swoop® System with Contrast Agents

articles.summary: Multiple peer-reviewed publications in Journal of Neurosurgery and Stroke strengthen evidence for portable MRI in stroke and neurosurgical settings.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces the Release of Multiple Peer-Reviewed Publications, Expanding Clinical Evidence for the Swoop® System Across a Growing Number of Sites of Care

articles.summary: Results from the NEURO PMR study, presented by Dr. Laszlo Mechtler at the ASN Annual Meeting in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on January 16, 2026.
articles.title: Hyperfine Announces NEURO PMR Study Results Showing High Diagnostic Value and Superior Patient Experience in Neurology Clinics
